text: Funds affiliated with the private equity firms Clearlake Capital Group and Insight Partners completed their acquisition of Alteryx on 19 March 2024, in a transaction valued at $4.4 billion including debt. Alteryx became a privately held company and its common stock stopped trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
short: Alteryx is owned by funds affiliated with Clearlake Capital and Insight Partners.

source.name: Alteryx – Clearlake Capital Group and Insight Partners Complete Acquisition of Alteryx (press release)
source.quote: Clearlake Capital Group, L.P. (“Clearlake”) and Insight Partners L.P. (“Insight”) today announced that their affiliated funds have completed the acquisition of Alteryx, Inc.

additionalSources.name: Clearlake Capital Group – Alteryx Enters into Definitive Agreement to be Acquired by Clearlake Capital Group and Insight Partners for $4.4 Billion (press release)
additionalSources.quote: two global private equity firms, in a transaction valued at $4.4 billion, including debt. Upon completion of the transaction, Alteryx will become a privately held company.
